The extension sends your key directly to the selected AI provider. Wooclap pages cannot read it. No cookies are used.

By default, keys are removed when Edge exits or the extension is reloaded or disabled. Remembered keys are stored locally without encryption by the extension, until you forget or replace them. Save a replacement with this box unchecked to return to session-only storage.
